title: Pelican website builds
description: Auto-builds the website with Pelican via CI2. Never builds from the asf-site branch. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#pelican

whoami.description: Branch this configuration applies to. 'asf-site' is not allowed.

target.description: Branch to push the built site to. Defaults to the current branch.

notify.description: Recipients of build notifications. Defaults to the project's commits list.

autobuild.description: Branch glob to auto-build with a dynamic staging profile, e.g. site/* or feature/*. Must end with /*.

minimum_page_count.description: Minimum number of pages the build must produce. Consumed by the ASF Pelican builder.
